title: A closed no-charge work order offers no Convert or Change category
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new No Charge work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, category Goodwill, closed.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the work order's three-dots menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The work order shows the status Closed with the "No Charge" badge.
  • The header card reads "Closed on [posting date]. To change it, reopen it from the Finance tab."
  • There is no Reopen button on the work order header.

Step 2:

  • The menu offers no "Change category", "Convert to Billable" or "Convert to No Charge".

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as the work order's number or the customer's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-R9: “From Close or invoice on, the classification and the category are locked: a closed no-charge work order shows the No Charge badge with no Convert or Change category action, on a closed internal or no-charge work order the Change Customer button on the customer card is disabled with the tooltip "Reopen the work order to change the customer." (the lock an invoiced or paid billable work order has today, S2-R7), and the header card carries the line "Closed on [posting date]. To change it, reopen it from the Finance tab." There is no Reopen control on the work order itself (Story 4).”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Closed work order header | "Closed on [posting date]. To change it, reopen it from the Finance tab." | Line on the header card, persists”
  • Key Decisions: “The classification can change until the work order is closed or invoiced. From then on it is locked.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Internal Work Orders · All flows v6" (https://claude.ai/artifact/5jHR3nLeDinzks1viREFuo), version 1794484794-2031, read and rendered 12 Nov 2026: boards "06 Closed · read-only" (page "Flow 2 · No charge on a customer's work order"), "01 Work order · Closed" (page "Flow 3 · Reopen"), "08 Work order · Closed, invoice" (page "Flow 1 · Create and close"), "18 Closed · INTERNAL document" (page "Happy flow v6").
